english.note: Exemption may apply for a US degree, a degree from a university in an IU-listed English-speaking country, or citizenship of a listed country. Funding or assistantships may still require an English exam.

documents: SOPHAS application and invited IU Graduate School supplemental application; both required
Statement of purpose, maximum 600 words, on motivation, readiness and personal qualities
Recommendation letters; general school guidance says most programs require three unless otherwise noted
Transcripts from all colleges and universities; foreign records/degree documents with certified translations when needed
Foreign PhD transcripts require official WES or ECE course-by-course evaluation sent directly to SOPHAS
requirements.note: Biostatistics admits applicants with a bachelor’s degree or higher; a master’s is not mandatory. Official transcripts go through SOPHAS; international applicants upload unofficial academic records and degree documents, with official verification as required. Final degree-conferral transcript due within three months of completion. Applicable application charges and waiver eligibility were not established; do not substitute the separate Biology fee.

funding.note: Funding is not guaranteed. Most doctoral students receive competitive student academic appointments including full tuition remission, monthly stipend and health insurance. Automatic consideration without a separate funding application; priority-deadline application recommended.
